question: Which of the following molecules has at least a 90º angle ?:
analysis: In chemistry, the shape of a molecule is determined by its molecular geometry. A molecule with at least a 90º angle would indicate a trigonal bipyramidal or octahedral geometry. Among the given options, SF4 (option d) and BF3 (option e) have at least a 90º angle due to their trigonal bipyramidal and planar triangular geometry, respectively.
